titulo: The list is ready, in seven slides
caption:
I was prepared for all of it except the five kilometers.
Choose friction.
Link in bio.
by NMR

alt.1: Cella at 11:00 p.m. in a brand-new scarf with the price tag hanging from its end, facing a wall half covered in neat paper strips, in the same room as the second slide: a floor lamp, a wall clock, a white door with a pair of sneakers by it
alt.2: the same room twice, 11:00 p.m. above and 6:00 a.m. below: a door with the same big paper strip reading Tomorrow., a window covered in strips, a small pile of fallen strips at the foot of the door, and Cella looking at the door; in the top room a second black Cella with a small red crown stands a short distance from her and tilts the crown toward the pile
alt.3: a question set at title size with three plain answers, and in a row on the floor a pair of sneakers, a packed backpack and a folded new scarf with its tag, with Cella standing beside them
alt.4: Cella leans her whole body against a white door and pushes it open onto warm dawn light; a sneaker has crossed the threshold and rests on the sill, and the paper strip that was on the door peels away
alt.5: Cella outdoors in warm dawn light, in her scarf, standing on the doormat with a sneaker beside her; behind her the open door shows the lavender room, with its lit lamp and the heap of fallen paper strips
alt.6: a long list in monospace hanging from a door above Cella, who looks at it; the last line, Steps: 1, is in bold
alt.7: the empty room seen from inside: the door open on warm dawn light with a tiny Cella far outside in it, the lamp still lit, a heap of paper strips and one strip reading Tomorrow. on the floor, and a sneaker on the sill
